post.description:
Run single-frame infrared intensity regression on authentic ISRO INSAT crop.

Enforces forensic release gate: validates model checksum before invocation.
Returns explicit state: VERIFIED_EXPERIMENTAL, UNVERIFIED_DATA, or INFERENCE_ERROR.

post.description:
Run ConvLSTM spatiotemporal sequence prediction on chronological satellite frames.

Returns 3 past input frames, predicted future intensity, and reconstructed next frame.
Enforces forensic release gate before execution.

schema.title: Response Infer Convlstm Api Ml Infer Convlstm Post

post.description:
Request multi-horizon trajectory & intensity inference from Vayumarg-Track-GRU.

Enforces forensic release gate: validates model checksum before invocation.
Loads chronological track history for the requested cyclone from the verified archive,
generates +6h, +12h, +24h forecasts, and benchmarks against Geodesic & Persistence baselines.

storm_name.title: Storm Name
storm_name.description: Storm name for authentic crop (e.g. BIPARJOY, AMPHAN, REMAL, DANA)

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.default: Great-Circle Geodesic Constant-Velocity Extrapolation + Persistence & Bounded-Trend Wind Intensity Baseline

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.default: Deterministic kinematic reference model. Does not simulate baroclinic environmental steering, vertical wind shear, or sea-surface heat flux.

provenance_note.title: Provenance Note
provenance_note.default: Strict temporal boundary enforced: no observation with timestamp > issue_time_utc is queried or utilized in prediction. Retrospective best tracks serve as simulated real-time inputs.

CycloneForecastOutput.title: CycloneForecastOutput
CycloneForecastOutput.description: Complete canonical forecast output strictly isolated from future observations.

ForecastHorizonPoint.title: ForecastHorizonPoint
ForecastHorizonPoint.description: Single predicted future track coordinate and intensity step.

storm_sid.title: Storm Sid
storm_sid.description: Canonical IBTrACS SID or storm name (e.g. 2023156N10067, BIPARJOY)

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Wind reference agency: IMD (3-min), JTWC (1-min), or IBTRACS

GeoJsonFeature.title: GeoJsonFeature
GeoJsonFeature.description: Standard RFC 7946 GeoJSON Feature with [longitude, latitude] coordinates.

GroundTruthObservation.title: GroundTruthObservation
GroundTruthObservation.description: Official cyclone intensity observation from a meteorological agency.

HindsightHorizonVerification.title: HindsightHorizonVerification
HindsightHorizonVerification.description: Verification comparison for a single forecast horizon against retrospective ground truth.

provenance_note.title: Provenance Note
provenance_note.default: Evaluated strictly post-prediction in a separate verification path. Actual observations are retrospective best-track fixes.

HindsightVerificationOutput.title: HindsightVerificationOutput
HindsightVerificationOutput.description: Separate hindsight verification report computed only post-prediction.

HistoricalObservationPoint.title: HistoricalObservationPoint
HistoricalObservationPoint.description: Historical observation fix consumed strictly up to issue time.

MotionVector.title: MotionVector
MotionVector.description: Estimated forward translation velocity vector derived from usable historical fixes.

ProvenanceRecord.title: ProvenanceRecord
ProvenanceRecord.description: Complete provenance and calibration lineage for an authentic satellite crop.
